rationale: Calibration covers two water levels (W3=TN2/3/4 and W1=TN10/11/12) × three non-zero nitrogen levels (N1/N2/N3), identifying growth, nitrogen-response, and harvest parameters. Validation holds out the zero-nitrogen treatments (N0) at both water levels (TN5=W3N0, TN13=W1N0), testing extrapolation to severe nitrogen stress. TN9/TN14 are incomplete intermediate-irrigation/CK treatments used only for diagnostic, never entering Phi.
limitations: Single-season internal validation; cannot substitute for cross-season or cross-site external validation. Paper must state this explicitly.
leakage_rule: Split by complete treatment blocks; never randomly partition time-series rows of the same treatment (would cause information leakage).
